WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT sp.zoneref AS zoneref,
         s.insurstat AS insurstat,
         AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaininggb,
         AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaininggb) AS mean_avg_remaininggb
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT g.zoneref,
       g.insurstat,
       g.avg_remaininggb,
       g.avg_cpu_gpu_gap,
       g.avg_remaininggb / NULLIF(o.mean_avg_remaininggb, 0) AS remaining_ratio
FROM grouped g
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE o.mean_avg_remaininggb IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY remaining_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
